$comment: P69 (lane `cs`, D-C-A-STATIC-UNION-INITIALIZED-THROUGH-A-LATER-MEMBER-IS-NOT-ENCODED): a union with static storage may be initialized through ANY member its initializer designates (C 6.7.9p17), and its static image is THAT member's bytes. DSS's MIR literal of a union did not say which member it held, and the static-data encoder paired the one value with the FIRST member. MEASURED before the fix (the lane's pre-fix dsscp, pe64 and ELF x86_64, probe un10b): a float member after an int (`{ .f = 42.0f }`), a structure member and a union beside a `_Complex` member could not be emitted at all (K_NoMatchingObjectFormat); a member WIDER than the first (`union { char c; int i; } = { .i = 0x01022A04 }`) was cut to the first member's width SILENTLY (byte 1 read back 0, not 42); and a 6-bit bit-field member after a 3-bit first (`{ .b = 42 }`) was cut to 3 bits SILENTLY (it read back 2). Now the literal names its member (`MirAggregateValue::unionMember`, set by both producers of a static image -- the whole fold and the static-data classifier a `_Complex` member routes through -- and spelled `lit agg member N` in .dssir v5) and the encoder writes the value through that member, refusing a union value that names none or a member the union lacks. Each object here is compared BYTE BY BYTE, through a volatile pointer, with the same member stored at run time; the exit code is 100 plus the first shape that differs (1 a float after an int, 2 a member wider than the first, 3 a structure member, 4 a const union, 5 a union nested in a structure, 6 an array of unions naming different members, 7 a static local, 8 a file-scope compound literal, 9 a bit-field past the first, 10 a union beside a `_Complex` member, 11 the first member -- the control). MEASURED 2026-10-07 through `dssharness run probe-reference-cc`, this file: gcc 13.3.0 and clang 18.1.3 at -std=c17 -pedantic-errors and -std=c2x build and run 42 (run 20261007-040425-b6f65fc0, host run 20261007-040415-7c231949), mingw-w64 gcc 13.2.0 in both modes too (20261007-040443-f6068627), MSVC 19.51 /std:clatest and /std:c17 too (20261007-040446-e0fb5677; it defines __STDC_NO_COMPLEX__, so shape 10 is not compiled there). Apple clang 21.0.0 in both modes too (run 20261007-192441-06d9d6ef, host run -192431-cfbf5c5e). The release arm is REPORT-ONLY: every image here is static data laid down at compile time.
